text.p: Shoney's Inc said on Tuesday it named Robert Langford, executive vice president, secretary and general counsel, to the posts of chief operating officer and executive vice president.
The company also said that W. Craig Barber, senior executive vice president and chief financial officer, will assume the additional function of chief administrative officer.
Deborah Hollis will continue as executive vice president for human resources with the added responsibility for government affairs.
All three will report directly to Chief Executive C. Stephen Lynn in a move towards further streamlining the restaurant chain's management structure, the company said.
